title: Original NCI logical canvas
summary: Created the logical canvas used to visualize and interact with non-coherent interconnect configurations.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Created the original NCI logical canvas tooling in Interconnect Architect.
Extended logical-canvas layout, connectivity, route visualization, filtering and interaction behavior.
Original NCI/NoC canvas work is associated with the internal Tower product; AMBA is converted to generic transport at interface bridges before entering its fabric.

notes: Original canvas ownership does not claim exclusive authorship of every later shared renderer or scene component.
